svg.title: Check each new manuscript draft with a headless agent
svg.desc: The agent runs a saved workflow that builds the manuscript and then launches a headless checking agent. Saved checking instructions, the current draft, and saved analysis results feed the checking agent. It reports a discrepancy between a statement that the mean test score decreased and a saved increase of 3.2 points. The report is saved separately from earlier reports and returned to the agent for review. The same procedure can check later drafts. The values are illustrative.
svg.text: Each new draft gets a check and a separate report
